stories.headline: Nuvei Case Turns Chargebacks Into an FTC Warning Sign
stories.body: Before a merchant can accept card payments, a processor or acquiring bank must decide whether to take on the business and its payment risk. stories.headline: After year of rapid growth, Ohio bank revamps its top ranks
stories.body: First Financial Bancorp in Cincinnati named Chief Financial Officer Jamie Anderson as president. The move positions Anderson as heir apparent to CEO Archie Brown, according to one analyst.

stories.headline: Kalshi asks CFTC to allow margin trading on its platform, letting users buy with borrowed funds
stories.body: It's the latest move by the company as it and other event contract exchanges seek to gain greater participation by institutional traders.
